notes.title: [Update Announcement] April 3, 16:00
notes.content:
[Update Announcement] April 3rd 16:00

Maintenance update content:
1. Warrior's assistant manufacturing abnormality
2. Two pathfinding errors in the client
3. In-game welfare link replacement
4. Some payment issues
5. Novice equipment changed to non-disassembled
6. Fixed the seven-day goal that cannot be completed in two people
7. Fixed the abnormal problem of team departure
8. Abnormal display of the task bar in the arena

Maintenance updates are based on actual time, please be patient!

notes.title: Demo trial officially starts today
notes.content:
Open World, the pure MMO game "Youxing Continent" officially started demo testing at 10am today. You can install and try it for free on Steam and Steam platform game stores. At the same time, the Spring Festival promotion will be launched simultaneously on Steam and Steam platforms. It is said that many game masterpieces will participate in discount promotions! In addition, this trial test will last for a relatively long time. Please follow our Q group or official website for the latest news on the specific end time.

　[b]official website：[/b]https://yxdl.sydsj.cc


[img]https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/45341092/d759564ce24f12b06ab02cc793fe9cc95056d82c.png[/img]

　[h3]　[b]Regarding this test[/b][/h3]

　　Test start time:：2025年1月27日（今日） 上午10:00（CST）

　　Test closure time: Regarding whether to keep the file, it may be adjusted according to the actual situation of the regional server. It can be played smoothly before the public beta.

[b]　　This demo trial does not participate in the paid testing on the official website, and in-game recharge will not be possible. If players need to participate in recharge rebates, please go to the official website to download the PC installation package to participate.[/b]
